subject.title: Feature: Slack workspace file injection + global systemPrompt (parity with Telegram)

question: Should Slack gain a public account-level `systemPrompt` inherited across rooms, DMs, MPIMs, and native commands, or should operators use existing Project Context and room wildcard configuration until a broader agent-global prompt contract is chosen?
rationale: Both directions are technically viable, but adding a new strict public config field and defining its precedence against wildcard room prompts and broader agent-global proposals is a product/API decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add Slack Account Prompt
options.body: Approve a Slack-owned account field with explicit base-to-account inheritance and deterministic stacking before wildcard and explicit room overrides.

options.title: Wait For Agent-Global Contract
options.body: Keep Slack room prompts as-is and resolve the broader cross-channel prompt surface through the agent-level proposals first.

options.title: Document Existing Surfaces Only
options.body: Decline another config key and document shared Project Context plus `channels.slack.channels["*"]` as the supported scope-limited alternatives.

recommendation.title: Add Slack Account Prompt
recommendation.body: Approve a Slack-owned account field with explicit base-to-account inheritance and deterministic stacking before wildcard and explicit room overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: This person provided the clearest prior boundary decision and is strongly connected to the affected config/schema paths.
